Capture observable behaviour through public members exactly as it exists. Do not improve,
refactor, repair or diagnose production code, and do not infer intended behaviour.

raw_plan_system_prompt:
You are planning regression characterisation tests for existing C# production code.
Work only from observable public behaviour in the pristine source and neutral dependency
context. Do not diagnose, improve, refactor or repair the production code.

Return ONLY one JSON object with suite_name and exactly five cases. Use these identifiers
and categories once each, in this order:
- H1 / happy_path: one representative valid end-to-end flow.
- E1 / empty_or_invalid: the most relevant empty, minimal, null or invalid-input flow.
- B1 / boundary_values: below, at and above one source-supported boundary. Put all three
  stimuli in inputs. If there is no numeric threshold, use the closest three-point
  cardinality or ordering boundary supported by the public contract.
- A1 / alternative_path: a materially different valid branch, mode or input partition.
- D1 / dependency_or_state: a deterministic dependency outcome, repeated invocation,
  duplicate input or state transition, choosing the first applicable option in that order.

Each case must contain case_id, category, source_evidence, input_partition, inputs and
expected_observation. Every input partition must differ. Evidence and expected observations
must describe behaviour visible in the supplied pristine code; do not invent requirements.
Do not include C# test code in this planning response.

test_cases.test_name: Valid standard GB order follows ordinary processing path
Empty order and address expose empty-input results
Minimum order value compares below at and above ten
Wholesale marketplace order uses wholesale branches
First dispatch calls shipper and records dispatched reference

cases.source_evidence: A valid standard-customer order meeting the minimum can be validated, taxed, manifested, classified, discounted and dispatched. GB resolves to 0.20 tax, positive quantities produce PARCEL entries, a Web total of exactly 100 is classified as small, and dispatch uses the standard service.
cases.input_partition: valid standard GB web order with one ordinary line

cases.source_evidence: An order with no lines adds "order has no lines" and, for a standard customer, "below minimum order value". An empty address fails CheckAddress, and an empty manifest is represented by a single "EMPTY" entry.
cases.input_partition: empty order and default standard customer

cases.source_evidence: MeetsMinimum sums positive-quantity line values and compares the total with the configured minimum using total >= 10. Standard customers below that threshold receive the validation problem "below minimum order value".
cases.input_partition: standard-order totals immediately below, exactly at and immediately above the minimum value

cases.source_evidence: Wholesale customers are exempt from minimum-value validation, receive tax multiplied by 0.9, receive a 10% subtotal discount, select freight service, and with more than five lines are classified as wholesale-bulk. Marketplace adds 1 to the discount for a non-blocked customer.
cases.input_partition: valid low-value wholesale DE marketplace order with six lines
cases.expected_observation: {"MeetsMinimum":false,"ValidateOrder":[],"ResolveRate_for_DE":0.19,"ComputeTax":1.03,"SelectService":"freight","Classify":"wholesale-bulk","ApplyDiscount":1.60,"BuildManifest":["PARCEL W1","PARCEL W2","PARCEL W3","PARCEL W4","PARCEL W5","PARCEL W6"]}

cases.source_evidence: On a first dispatch for a non-blocked standard customer in a served country, Dispatch passes the order reference and selected standard service to IShipper.CreateLabel, returns the dependency's label, records the reference, and increments DispatchedCount.
cases.input_partition: first dispatch using a deterministic shipper response
